facts.fact: Morocco's High Commission for Planning presented results of the general population and housing census conducted in September 2024.
HCP reported from the 2024 census that 70.2% of urban and 40.4% of rural residents aged 15 and over used the internet in the three months before the census.
HCP reported from the 2024 census that 64.4% of men and 55% of women aged 15 and over used the internet, a gap of 14.6% of men's rate.

MAR.note: The 59.6% internet use figure is for people aged 15 and over only, so it is noted and not used.
The 84.4% phone ownership figure is for people aged 15 and over, not 10 and over, so it is not recorded.
The document says nothing about police station records.
